## Change

Describe the reusable improvement and who it helps.

## Evidence

Source URLs, versions/commits, inspection date, rights and what was actually verified.

## Checks

- [ ] Ran `python scripts/validate.py`.
- [ ] Reviewed the diff for private data and machine-specific paths.
- [ ] Kept source attribution, licenses and status claims accurate.
- [ ] Updated changelog and affected counts/artwork where applicable.
